blocks.text: The concert promoter behind Moira Dela Torre’s “Where It All Started” show announced its postponement, five days before the event was scheduled to take place on Oct. 4. Ovation Productions released a statement on the matter through its Facebook page on Tuesday, Sept. 29. “We regret to announce that the MOIRA: ‘Where It All Started’ concert scheduled for Oct. 4, 2026 at SM Mall of Asia Arena has been postponed to next year,” it said, without disclosing the reason. “We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
